question: What is the maximum number of credit hours I can take in a regular semester?
expected_answer: 20 credit hours for a full-time student in a regular semester (minimum is 12). Taking more needs approval.

question: What CGPA puts me on academic probation, and does it limit my credit load?
expected_answer: Probation if 1.67 <= CGPA < 2.00. A student on probation can carry at most 18 credits.

question: When will a student be dismissed from the university?
expected_answer: If CGPA is below 1.67; or the student fails to reach a CGPA of 2.00 while on probation; or gets probation for the third time (non-consecutive).

question: Can I repeat a course that I already passed to improve my grade?
expected_answer: Yes, with approval of the Dean of the Centre of Studies: once per course, up to a maximum of 2 courses. The lower grade is recorded as RPT and excluded from the GPA.

question: What is the maximum time allowed to finish my degree?
expected_answer: 12 regular semesters, excluding leave of absence (minimum is 4 regular semesters).

question: When is the mid-semester break in Semester II 2026/2027?
expected_answer: 10 April 2027 (Saturday) to 18 April 2027 (Sunday), 9 days.

question: I'm a BCS student, batch 251. What are the prerequisites for Data Structures and Algorithms?
expected_answer: BICS 2302 Data Structures and Algorithms (3 credits) requires BICS 1304 Object-Oriented Programming and BICS 1305 Discrete Structures.

question: I'm a BCS student, batch 211. What is the prerequisite for Data Structures and Algorithms?
expected_answer: CSCI 2300 Data Structures and Algorithms I (3 credits) requires CSCI 1301 Object-Oriented Programming.

question: I'm in BIT batch 241. What do I need to pass before taking Final Year Project I?
expected_answer: BIIT 4321 Final Year Project I requires BIIT 1301 Database Programming, BIIT 2303 Network Infrastructure Management and BIIT 2305 Web Application Development.

question: How many credit hours is Industrial Attachment for BIT batch 261?
expected_answer: 11 credit hours (BIIT 4902), taken after completing all courses. Note: batch 241 is 9 credits, so the answer depends on batch. The plan's page 2 lists the code as BICS 4902, an inconsistency in the source.

question: BCS batch 241: how many credits is the Final Year Project, and when can I register for FYP I?
expected_answer: 7 credits in total: BICS 4321 FYP I (3 credits) and BICS 4421 FYP II (4 credits). FYP I requires at least 90 earned credits; FYP II requires FYP I.

question: How much does it cost to withdraw from a course?
expected_answer: RM300 per course to withdraw within the deadline (weeks 5-10, UG04 form) and RM500 per course after it (weeks 11-13, UG05 form), paid at Finance Zone 2.

question: Until which week can I drop a course, and what can I do after that?
expected_answer: You can drop a course until week 4 of a regular semester, and it won't appear on your transcript. From week 5 to week 13 you can only withdraw, which gives a W grade.

question: When does online pre-registration for next semester's courses usually open?
expected_answer: Usually in week 9-10 of the previous semester. You can keep registering online until week 1 of the new semester while sections are still available.

question: What happens if I don't register for any courses this semester?
expected_answer: By week 4 you get NR (Not Registered) status. If you are still NR by week 12 you are terminated (TD) from your studies and have to appeal to the Senate for reinstatement.

question: I'm BIT batch 221. Which courses do I need to pass before Final Year Project I?
expected_answer: INFO 4401 Final Year Project I (4 credit hours) requires CSCI 1304, CSCI 2301, INFO 2303, INFO 2304, INFO 2305 and INFO 3305.
key_facts: CSCI 1304; CSCI 2301; INFO 2303; INFO 2304; INFO 2305; INFO 3305

question: The course I need is full. What are my options?
expected_answer: Look for another section of the same course and keep checking during add/drop, as places open when others drop. If it is a study-plan course and no section is available, appeal to the kulliyyah office (kict_academic@iium.edu.my); if that fails, re-plan with your advisor.

question: I haven't passed the prerequisite but I need the course this semester. Can I still register?
expected_answer: Not directly. A prerequisite waiver is exceptional: apply in writing through the kulliyyah office with a justification, and it needs the approval of the department offering the course.

question: I'm BIT batch 241. How many credit hours do I need to graduate?
expected_answer: At least 125 credit hours (batch 241 onwards, for both Malaysian and international students). A CGPA of at least 2.0 is also required.

question: I'm a BCS student from batch 211. How many credit hours do I need to graduate?
expected_answer: Batch 211 follows the batch 201 study plan: at least 130 credit hours, published as 132 for Malaysian students and 130 for international students.

question: I'm in BIT batch 261. How many credit hours must I complete before I can register for FYP?
expected_answer: At least 78 credit hours for the batch 261 study plan (batches 201 and 241 need 90). You also need to pass the relevant core courses and have a proposal approved by a supervisor.

question: How many credit hours of electives do BIT batch 241 students take?
expected_answer: 18 credit hours of field electives, from the approved list for the batch, and 12 credit hours of free electives.

question: How many semesters of leave of absence can I take?
expected_answer: Up to two semesters or one academic session, with the approval of the Dean of the Centre of Studies. Longer leave needs a recommendation from the Deans' Council and Senate endorsement.
key_facts: 2 semester|two semester|one academic session|1 academic session

question: What is the lowest mark that still counts as a pass?
expected_answer: 50% (grade C, 2.00 points). 45-49 is a D, which is a fail.

question: What do I need to make the Dean's List?
expected_answer: A GPA of 3.50 or above for the semester, at least 12 registered credits, and passing all courses.

question: I'm BIT batch 241. I got 55% overall in a course but only 20% in the final exam. Did I pass?
expected_answer: No. The BIT handbook requires at least 25% in both the continuous assessment and the final assessment as well as 50% overall, so 20% in the final exam is a fail even with 55% overall.
